{{Quote|Obi-Wan, there's assassin probes down here. One made it up the lift. I'll try to hold the others here.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref>}}
An '''assassin probe''' was one of three smuggled onto the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] during its voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|assassinate]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. It reached the dining level of the ''Coronet'', where it was destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
